capabilities: Create daily notes inside their own dated folders
Append one-line summaries to daily note filenames
Navigate to the nearest previous or next daily note
Apply Moment.js-formatted templates to new daily notes
Rename a daily folder and its note together
disambiguation: Not a folder-management tool; it creates daily notes that each live in their own folder named after the day.
extras: The README warns that plugins relying on the daily-notes implementation, such as Calendar, will likely break with named folders, and recommends the core daily-notes plugin instead if per-day folders are not needed. Known limitations listed: only fixed-length date formats, no nested folder locations, and previous/next navigation scans all markdown files, which may not scale to large vaults.
intentEvidence: exactly like the official daily-note plugin, except for the fact (1) that the daily note is created inside
motivation: The author uses Obsidian as a lab journal for research and needed to keep experimental images together with each daily note and to summarize each day in the filename, which the official daily-notes plugin could not do.
problem: Core daily notes create one date-named file, so attachments for a day cannot be kept in a matching per-day folder and filenames cannot carry a short description.

relations.evidence: exactly like the official daily-note plugin, except for the fact (1) that the daily note is created

summary: Daily notes plugin that creates each daily note inside its own dated folder, with an optional one-line summary appended to the filename.
